data.text:
Ram Dulare vs Sri Murli Manohar Lal Commissioner Food ... on 
29 January, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:8141
Court No. - 19 
Case :- Contempt Application (Civil) No. - 1539 of 2016
Applicant :- Ram Dulare 
Opposite Party :- Sri Murli Manohar Lal Commissioner Food Safety And Drug Admini Counsel for Applicant :- Indrapal Singh Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Case called out.
None present for the petitioners, whereas, Sri Sunil Bajpai, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State submits that the order dated 27-04-2016, passed by the writ court has been complied with in it's letter and spirit.
In view of aforesaid, no contempt is made out. 
The contempt notices are hereby discharged. 
The contempt petition is dismissed. 
However, it is provided that if the petitioner feels aggrieved with the order passed by the opposite party, he may challenge the same before the appropriate court/forum.
